text.2:85: Yet ye it is who slay each other and drive out a party of your people from their homes, supporting one another against them by sin and transgression? - and if they came to you as captives ye would ransom them, whereas their expulsion was itself unlawful for you - Believe ye in part of the Scripture and disbelieve ye in part thereof? And what is the reward of those who do so save ignominy in the life of the world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be consigned to the most grievous doom. For Allah is not unaware of what ye do.
text.2:191: And slay them wherever ye find them, and drive them out of the places whence they drove you out, for persecution is worse than slaughter. And fight not with them at the Inviolable Place of Worship until they first attack you there, but if they attack you (there) then slay them. Such is the reward of disbelievers.
text.3:87: As for such, their guerdon is that on them rests the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.
text.3:136: The reward of such will be forgiveness from their Lord, and Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever - a bountiful reward for workers!
text.4:93: Whoso slayeth a believer of set purpose, his reward is hell for ever. Allah is wroth against him and He hath cursed him and prepared for him an awful doom.
text.5:29: Lo! I would rather thou shouldst bear the punishment of the sin against me and thine own sin and become one of the owners of the fire. That is the reward of evil-doers.
text.5:33: The only reward of those who make war upon Allah and His messenger and strive after corruption in the land will be that they will be killed or crucified, or have their hands and feet on alternate sides cut off, or will be expelled out of the land. Such will be their degradation in the world, and in the Hereafter theirs will be an awful doom;
text.5:38: As for the thief, both male and female, cut off their hands. It is the reward of their own deeds, an exemplary punishment from Allah. Allah is Mighty, Wise.
text.5:85: Allah hath rewarded them for that their saying - Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of the good.
text.5:95: O ye who believe! Kill no wild game while ye are on the pilgrimage. Whoso of you killeth it of set purpose he shall pay its forfeit in the equivalent of that which he hath killed, of domestic animals, the judge to be two men among you known for justice, (the forfeit) to be brought as an offering to the Ka'bah; or, for expiation, he shall feed poor persons, or the equivalent thereof in fasting, that he may taste the evil consequences of his deed. Allah forgiveth whatever (of this kind) may have happened in the past, but whoso relapseth, Allah will take retribution from him. Allah is Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong).
text.9:26: Then Allah sent His peace of reassurance down upon His messenger and upon the believers, and sent down hosts ye could not see, and punished those who disbelieved. Such is the reward of disbelievers.
text.9:82: Then let them laugh a little: they will weep much, as the reward of what they used to earn.
text.9:95: They will swear by Allah unto you, when ye return unto them, that ye may let them be. Let them be, for lo! they are unclean, and their abode is hell as the reward for what they used to earn.
text.10:27: And those who earn ill-deeds, (for them) requital of each ill-deed by the like thereof; and ignominy overtaketh them - They have no protector from Allah - as if their faces had been covered with a cloak of darkest night. Such are rightful owners of the Fire; they will abide therein.
text.12:25: And they raced with one another to the door, and she tore his shirt from behind, and they met her lord and master at the door. She said: What shall be his reward, who wisheth evil to thy folk, save prison or a painful doom?
text.12:74: They said: And what shall be the penalty for it, if ye prove liars?
text.12:75: They said: The penalty for it! He in whose bag (the cup) is found, he is the penalty for it. Thus we requite wrong-doers.
text.17:63: He said: Go, and whosoever of them followeth thee - lo! hell will be your payment, ample payment.
text.17:98: That is their reward because they disbelieved Our revelations and said: When we are bones and fragments shall we, forsooth, be raised up as a new creation?
text.18:88: But as for him who believeth and doeth right, good will be his reward, and We shall speak unto him a mild command.
text.18:106: That is their reward: hell, because they disbelieved, and made a jest of Our revelations and Our messengers.
text.20:76: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. That is the reward of him who groweth.
text.25:15: Say: Is that (doom) better or the Garden of Immortality which is promised unto those who ward off (evil)? It will be their reward and journey's end.
text.32:17: No soul knoweth what is kept hid for them of joy, as a reward for what they used to do.
text.34:37: And it is not your wealth nor your children that will bring you near unto Us, but he who believeth and doeth good (he draweth near). As for such, theirs will be twofold reward for what they did and they will dwell secure in lofty halls.
text.39:34: They shall have what they will of their Lord's bounty. That is the reward of the good:
text.41:28: That is the reward of Allah's enemies: the Fire. Therein is their immortal home, payment forasmuch as they denied Our revelations.
text.42:40: The guerdon of an ill-deed is an ill the like thereof. But whosoever pardoneth and amendeth, his wage is the affair of Allah. Lo! He loveth not wrong-doers.
text.46:14: Such are rightful owners of the Garden, immortal therein, as a reward for what they used to do.
text.53:41: And afterward he will be repaid for it with fullest payment;
text.54:14: That ran (upon the waters) in Our sight, as a reward for him who was rejected.
text.55:60: Is the reward of goodness aught save goodness?
text.56:24: Reward for what they used to do.
text.59:17: And the consequence for both will be that they are in the Fire, therein abiding. Such is the reward of evil-doers.
text.76:9: (Saying): We feed you, for the sake of Allah only. We wish for no reward nor thanks from you;
text.76:22: (And it will be said unto them): Lo! this is a reward for you. Your endeavour (upon earth) hath found acceptance.
text.78:36: Requital from thy Lord - a gift in payment -
text.98:8: Their reward is with their Lord: Gardens of Eden underneath which rivers flow, wherein they dwell for ever. Allah hath pleasure in them and they have pleasure in Him. This is (in store) for him who feareth his Lord.
